| 数学本质 | 平均 per-step 差异 | 总差异量级 (= sqrt(Σ‖d_t‖²)) |

**Adaptive K**（`generate_adaptive_k_samples`, smolvla_wrapper.py:332）:

diff = samples[:, 0, :, :7] - samples[:, 1, :, :7]  # (B, 5, 7)

a1 = k_pose[0].reshape(-1)  # (30,) = 5步×6D
